prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1455; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: This summary describes the care provided to a patient who presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and sustained a fracture of the wrist. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash. Initial imaging and physical examination clearly confirmed the fracture, and immobilization and supportive care were started promptly. Over the course of twenty visits, treatment followed a typical progression, with frequency of visits tapering as the patient's range of motion, grip strength, and pain levels improved steadily. No prior injury to the same area of the body is known from the patient's history or records. Billing reviewed for this episode of care shows no repeated or duplicate charges for services rendered. The patient is now discharged from active treatment with a stable healing pattern, and follow-up is recommended only if symptoms recur.
